CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Date_Contract_Signed__c),TODAY()+7, CASE( MOD(Date_Contract_Signed__c - DATE(1985, 6, 24), 7), 0, Date_Contract_Signed__c + 3 + FLOOR((2 + 3 - 1) / 5) * 2, 1, Date_Contract_Signed__c + 3 + FLOOR((3 + 3) / 5) * 2, 2, Date_Contract_Signed__c + 3 + FLOOR((4 + 3) / 5) * 2, 3, Date_Contract_Signed__c + 3 + FLOOR((5 + 3) / 5) * 2, 4, Date_Contract_Signed__c + 3 + FLOOR((6 + 3) / 5) * 2, 5, Date_Contract_Signed__c + 3 + CEILING((1 + 3) / 5) * 2, 6, Date_Contract_Signed__c - IF(3 > 0, 1, 0) + 3 + CEILING((2 + 3) / 5) * 2, null ))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Deposit is due 5 Business Days after the contract is signed. If no contract has been signed, this date is 7 calendar days in the future
CustomField.label: Deposit Due by
